zara: Noticed a tiny spike of WS reconnects on prod-eu at 08:03. reconnects >> resume successes for tenant Beta-3
owen: Logs show server sending HTTP 204 then closing TCP. Clients reopen but never send resume.
zara: That's the new idle-close handler we toggled on Beta-3 yesterday. Might be a semantic mismatch with LB.
telemetry-bot: increase(streaming_reconnects_total{tenant="Beta-3"}[5m]) = 420; increase(stream_resume_success_total{tenant="Beta-3"}[5m]) = 6
owen: Proposed quick fix: add header `x-rw-stream-close: idle` on those responses so gateway treats it as EOF. Also add metric `stream_close_reason_total{reason="idle_handler"}`
ops-bot: rollout-bot: feature/idle-close canary deployed to Beta-3 at 08:00 (1/3 nodes) completed 08:02 (3/3 nodes)
zara: I'll roll back Beta-3 to previous config and open ENG-3601 to track header + metrics work.
owen: Also add dashboard card: reconnects/resumes ratio and close-code breakdown.
zara: Revert in progress. Will report back in 5m.
